name: iOS Build on macOS Runner

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
    paths-ignore:            # doc-only pushes don't burn macOS minutes
      - "**.md"
      - ".gitignore"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:                 # a newer push cancels the older running build
  group: ios-build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:

      # =========================================================
      # 1. CHECKOUT
      # =========================================================
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # =========================================================
      # 2. GENERATE BUILD INFO (so every binary can be identified —
      #    prints the exact commit SHA in the on-device debug log)
      # =========================================================
      - name: Generate Build Info
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "GENERATING BUILD INFO"
          echo "=========================================="

          BUILD_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}"
          BUILD_TIME="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"

          {
            echo "#pragma once"
            echo "#define SANTA_BUILD_SHA \"${BUILD_SHA}\""
            echo "#define SANTA_BUILD_TIME \"${BUILD_TIME}\""
          } > ios/BuildInfo.h

          echo "Build SHA:  ${BUILD_SHA}"
          echo "Build Time: ${BUILD_TIME}"
          cat ios/BuildInfo.h

      # =========================================================
      # 3. CHECK PROJECT
      # =========================================================
      - name: Check Project Files
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "PROJECT CHECK"
          echo "=========================================="

          pwd
          ls -la

          echo ""
          echo "Checking project.yml..."

          if [ ! -f "project.yml" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: project.yml not found."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "project.yml found."

          echo ""
          echo "Checking xmas.xpk..."

          if [ ! -f "assets/xmas.xpk" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: assets/xmas.xpk NOT FOUND."
            echo ""
            echo "Assets directory:"
            ls -lah assets 2>/dev/null || true
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "SUCCESS: xmas.xpk found."

          ls -lh "assets/xmas.xpk"
          du -h "assets/xmas.xpk"

      # =========================================================
      # 3. CHECK SOURCE
      # =========================================================
      - name: Check Source Files
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "SOURCE FILES"
          echo "=========================================="

          find ios src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort

      # =========================================================
      # 4. COMPILE DESKTOP TEST
      # =========================================================
      - name: Compile C++ Test
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "C++ TEST BUILD"
          echo "=========================================="

          clang++ \
            -std=c++17 \
            -o engine_test \
            src/main.cpp \
            src/AssetManager.cpp \
            src/XFileParser.cpp \
            -lz

          echo ""
          echo "C++ test compiled successfully."

          echo ""
          echo "=========================================="
          echo "RUNNING C++ TEST"
          echo "=========================================="

          ./engine_test || true

      # =========================================================
      # 4b. VERIFY GAME DATA (real xmas.xpk against the parsers)
      #     catalog meshes, all level objects, all textures decode
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify Game Data
        run: |
          set -e

          clang++ \
            -std=c++17 \
            -Isrc \
            -o verify_assets \
            tools/verify_assets.cpp \
            src/AssetManager.cpp \
            src/TextureLoader.cpp \
            src/ElementCatalog.cpp \
            src/LevelParser.cpp \
            src/AniParser.cpp \
            src/XFileParser.cpp \
            -lz

          ./verify_assets assets/xmas.xpk

      # =========================================================
      # 4c. METAL TOOLCHAIN (only needed on newer Xcode images;
      #     harmless / ignored on older ones)
      # =========================================================
      - name: Metal Toolchain
        continue-on-error: true
        run: xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain

      # =========================================================
      # 5. INSTALL XCODEGEN
      # =========================================================
      - name: Install XcodeGen
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "INSTALLING XCODEGEN"
          echo "=========================================="

          if command -v xcodegen >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "XcodeGen already installed."
          else
            brew install xcodegen
          fi

          xcodegen --version

      # =========================================================
      # 6. GENERATE XCODE PROJECT
      # =========================================================
      - name: Generate Xcode Project
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "GENERATING XCODE PROJECT"
          echo "=========================================="

          rm -rf SantaEngine.xcodeproj

          xcodegen generate

          if [ ! -d "SantaEngine.xcodeproj" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine.xcodeproj was not generated."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "Xcode project generated successfully."

      # =========================================================
      # 7. BUILD IOS APP
      # =========================================================
      - name: Build iOS App
        run: |
          set -eo pipefail

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "BUILDING IOS APP"
          echo "=========================================="

          rm -rf build

          xcodebuild \
            -project SantaEngine.xcodeproj \
            -scheme SantaEngine \
            -sdk iphoneos \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
            -configuration Release \
            -derivedDataPath build \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO 2>&1 | tee xcodebuild.log

          echo ""
          echo "iOS build completed successfully."

      # =========================================================
      # 7b. ON FAILURE: show the compiler errors right in the log
      # =========================================================
      - name: Show Build Errors
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "=========== error lines ==========="
          grep -E "error:|fatal error:|Undefined symbols|ld: " xcodebuild.log | head -60 || true
          echo "=========== last 40 lines ==========="
          tail -40 xcodebuild.log || true

      - name: Upload Build Log
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: xcodebuild-log
          path: xcodebuild.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

      # =========================================================
      # 8. FIND APP
      # =========================================================
      - name: Locate Built App
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "LOCATING SANTAENGINE.APP"
          echo "=========================================="

          find build \
            -type d \
            -name "SantaEngine.app" \
            -print

          APP_PATH="$(find build -type d -name "SantaEngine.app" | head -n 1)"

          if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine.app was not found."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "APP FOUND:"
          echo "$APP_PATH"

          echo "$APP_PATH" > app_path.txt

          echo ""
          echo "APP SIZE:"
          du -sh "$APP_PATH"

      # =========================================================
      # 9. VERIFY EXECUTABLE
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify App Executable
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "VERIFYING EXECUTABLE"
          echo "=========================================="

          if [ ! -f "$APP_PATH/SantaEngine" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine executable is missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Executable found:"
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/SantaEngine"

          echo ""
          echo "File type:"
          file "$APP_PATH/SantaEngine"

      # =========================================================
      # 10. VERIFY INFO.PLIST
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify Info Plist
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "VERIFYING INFO.PLIST"
          echo "=========================================="

          if [ ! -f "$APP_PATH/Info.plist" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Info.plist is missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Info.plist found."
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/Info.plist"

      # =========================================================
      # 11. COPY GAME DATA INTO APP
      # =========================================================
      - name: Copy Game Data Into App
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "COPYING XMAS.XPK INTO APP"
          echo "=========================================="

          if [ ! -f "assets/xmas.xpk" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Source assets/xmas.xpk does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "Source XPK:"
          ls -lh "assets/xmas.xpk"

          echo ""
          echo "Destination:"
          echo "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

          cp "assets/xmas.xpk" "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

          echo ""
          echo "XPK copied successfully."

          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

      # =========================================================
      # 12. VERIFY GAME DATA INSIDE APP
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify Game Data Inside App
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "VERIFYING GAME DATA INSIDE APP"
          echo "=========================================="

          echo ""
          echo "APP CONTENTS:"
          ls -lah "$APP_PATH"

          echo ""
          echo "SEARCHING FOR XPK:"
          find "$APP_PATH" -type f -iname "*.xpk" -print

          echo ""
          echo "CHECKING xmas.xpk..."

          if [ ! -f "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: xmas.xpk is NOT inside SantaEngine.app."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "SUCCESS: xmas.xpk is inside SantaEngine.app."

          echo ""
          echo "XPK SIZE:"
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"
          du -h "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

      # =========================================================
      # 13. VERIFY XPK SOURCE AND APP SIZE
      # =========================================================
      - name: Compare XPK Source And App
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "COMPARING XPK"
          echo "=========================================="

          SOURCE_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "assets/xmas.xpk")
          APP_SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk")

          echo "Source XPK: ${SOURCE_SIZE} bytes"
          echo "App XPK:    ${APP_SIZE} bytes"

          if [ "$SOURCE_SIZE" -ne "$APP_SIZE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: XPK size changed during copy."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "SUCCESS: XPK copied correctly."

      # =========================================================
      # 14. SHOW FINAL APP
      # =========================================================
      - name: Show Final App
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "FINAL SANTAENGINE.APP"
          echo "=========================================="

          echo ""
          echo "Total APP size:"
          du -sh "$APP_PATH"

          echo ""
          echo "APP CONTENTS:"
          find "$APP_PATH" -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort

          echo ""
          echo "XPK:"
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

      # =========================================================
      # 15. CREATE PAYLOAD
      # =========================================================
      - name: Create IPA Payload
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "CREATING PAYLOAD"
          echo "=========================================="

          rm -rf Payload
          rm -f SantaEngine.ipa

          mkdir -p Payload

          cp -R "$APP_PATH" "Payload/SantaEngine.app"

          echo ""
          echo "Payload created."

          ls -lah Payload

      # =========================================================
      # 16. VERIFY PAYLOAD
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify IPA Payload
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "VERIFYING PAYLOAD"
          echo "=========================================="

          if [ ! -d "Payload/SantaEngine.app" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Payload/SantaEngine.app missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -f "Payload/SantaEngine.app/SantaEngine" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine executable missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -f "Payload/SantaEngine.app/Info.plist" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Info.plist missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ ! -f "Payload/SantaEngine.app/xmas.xpk" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: xmas.xpk missing from Payload."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "SUCCESS: Payload contains all required files."

          echo ""
          echo "Payload size:"
          du -sh Payload

          echo ""
          echo "Payload XPK:"
          ls -lh "Payload/SantaEngine.app/xmas.xpk"

      # =========================================================
      # 17. CREATE IPA
      # =========================================================
      - name: Package IPA
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "CREATING SANTAENGINE.IPA"
          echo "=========================================="

          rm -f SantaEngine.ipa

          ditto \
            -c \
            -k \
            --sequesterRsrc \
            --keepParent \
            Payload \
            SantaEngine.ipa

          if [ ! -f "SantaEngine.ipa" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine.ipa was not created."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "IPA CREATED:"
          ls -lh SantaEngine.ipa

          IPA_BYTES=$(stat -f%z SantaEngine.ipa)

          echo ""
          echo "IPA SIZE:"
          echo "${IPA_BYTES} bytes"

          if [ "$IPA_BYTES" -lt 102400 ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "ERROR: IPA is suspiciously small."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "IPA size check passed."

      # =========================================================
      # 18. VERIFY FINAL IPA
      # =========================================================
      - name: Verify Final IPA Contents
        run: |
          set -e

          echo "=========================================="
          echo "VERIFYING FINAL IPA"
          echo "=========================================="

          echo ""
          echo "IPA CONTENTS:"
          unzip -l SantaEngine.ipa

          echo ""
          echo "Checking executable..."

          if unzip -l SantaEngine.ipa | grep -q "Payload/SantaEngine.app/SantaEngine"; then
            echo "SUCCESS: SantaEngine executable found."
          else
            echo "ERROR: SantaEngine executable missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "Checking xmas.xpk..."

          if unzip -l SantaEngine.ipa | grep -q "Payload/SantaEngine.app/xmas.xpk"; then
            echo "SUCCESS: xmas.xpk found inside IPA."
          else
            echo "ERROR: xmas.xpk NOT found inside IPA."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo ""
          echo "Checking Info.plist..."

          if unzip -l SantaEngine.ipa | grep -q "Payload/SantaEngine.app/Info.plist"; then
            echo "SUCCESS: Info.plist found."
          else
            echo "ERROR: Info.plist missing."
            exit 1
          fi

      # =========================================================
      # 19. FINAL REPORT
      # =========================================================
      - name: Final Build Report
        run: |
          set -e

          APP_PATH="$(cat app_path.txt)"

          echo ""
          echo "================================================"
          echo "          SANTAENGINE IOS BUILD REPORT"
          echo "================================================"

          echo ""
          echo "APP SIZE:"
          du -sh "$APP_PATH"

          echo ""
          echo "EXECUTABLE:"
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/SantaEngine"

          echo ""
          echo "GAME DATA:"
          ls -lh "$APP_PATH/xmas.xpk"

          echo ""
          echo "IPA:"
          ls -lh SantaEngine.ipa

          echo ""
          echo "================================================"
          echo "       BUILD + GAME DATA + IPA OK"
          echo "================================================"

      # =========================================================
      # 20. UPLOAD IPA
      # =========================================================
      - name: Upload IPA Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SantaEngine-IPA
          path: SantaEngine.ipa
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
